annotations.text:
Yeshiva Donor CRM — wireframes for the written spec (docs/donor-crm/spec/ on GitHub).
Top row: the daily loop (A1–A4, Phase 1). Bottom row: fundraising management (A5–A8, mostly Phase 2).
All names and numbers are invented demo data. Spec text is the source of truth; these frames illustrate it.
THE DAILY LOOP — open in the morning (A1/A4), know who needs you; after every call, log it in under 30 seconds (A3); before any call, understand the whole relationship in one screen (A2).
MANAGING THE MONEY — asks move through stages and visibly rot when neglected (A5); lists are work queues (A6); Gift Aid claims build themselves (A7); every report ends in a list of people (A8).
